# Bamboo King's Community Flavor Pack — files used in this mod

- 模组 / Mod: 竹子大王的社区DLC / Bamboo King's Community Flavor Pack（Steam 创意工坊 / Workshop 3763953914），竹子大王
- 经竹子大王本人同意使用（2026-11-20）
- 日期 / Date: 2026-11-20
- 生成 / Generated by: tools_20261117/gen_yuan_portraits.py (it verifies the source hashes below on every run)
- 用途 / Use: 大元皇帝、诸王、朝臣、行省长官的肖像官服与冠帽（四档圆领袍、蒙古交领衣、蒙古帽、展脚幞头、垂翅幞头）。
  Portrait robes and hats for the Yuan emperor, princes, court and branch-secretariat governors.
- 改动 / Changes: files renamed to the prefix oe_yp_; the .asset definitions, accessories, variations, genes, portrait
  modifiers and triggers are our own (rewritten for our names and our selection rules); the soft futou gets the three
  textures its .asset named but did not have next to it (the pack's 一山冠 textures, copied under the futou's name).
  Meshes and textures are byte-identical copies.
- 来源说明 / Provenance: the pack's own audit (docs/history/整理报告.md) calls its bk_ models original; the Mongol robe mesh
  is a reworked copy of vanilla male_clothes_chinese_commoner_yi (same size and shape name) and its normal map is
  byte-identical to vanilla's, i.e. Paradox material that mods may use.
- 合计 / Total: 26 files, 29921862 bytes (28.5 MB). The .dds files are outside git like the mod's
  other .dds art (.gitignore); the release script picks them up from the working tree.
